# Get all subnets and check for network interfaces in each for region in us-east-1 us-west-1 us-west-2; do echo "=== Region: $region ===" subnets=$(aws ec2 describe-subnets --region $region --query 'Subnets[*].SubnetId' --output text) for subnet in $subnets; do eni_count=$(aws ec2 describe-network-interfaces --region $region --filters "Name=subnet-id,Values=$subnet" --query 'length(NetworkInterfaces)' --output text) echo "$subnet: $eni_count network interfaces" done done

# Create a comprehensive report of empty subnets cat > /tmp/empty_subnets.txt << 'EOF' SUBNETS WITH NO NETWORK INTERFACES =================================== EOF for region in us-east-1 us-west-1 us-west-2; do echo "Region: $region" >> /tmp/empty_subnets.txt echo "==================" >> /tmp/empty_subnets.txt subnets=$(aws ec2 describe-subnets --region $region --query 'Subnets[*].[SubnetId,VpcId,CidrBlock,State]' --output text) while IFS=$'\t' read -r subnet_id vpc_id cidr state; do eni_count=$(aws ec2 describe-network-interfaces --region $region --filters "Name=subnet-id,Values=$subnet_id" --query 'length(NetworkInterfaces)' --output text) if [ "$eni_count" -eq 0 ]; then echo " - $subnet_id (VPC: $vpc_id, CIDR: $cidr, State: $state)" >> /tmp/empty_subnets.txt fi done <<< "$subnets" echo "" >> /tmp/empty_subnets.txt done cat /tmp/empty_subnets.txt
